indicator_name: Real minimum wage, minimum pension and MRP; Kaitz index; minimum wage over the subsistence minimum, monthly (computed by this repository)
description: Реальные МЗП, минимальная пенсия и МРП; индекс Кейтца; МЗП к прожиточному минимуму, помесячно (расчёт репозитория)
methodology: SOCIAL_STANDARDS deflated by the CPI level (chained CPI m/m, 2015 average = 1). KAITZ_INDEX = MZP over the average monthly wage of the quarter (AVG_WAGE_1T_QUARTERLY, each month of the quarter takes the quarter's wage; from 2015). MZP_TO_VPM_BNS and VPM_LAW_TO_VPM_BNS compare with the BNS price-based subsistence minimum (SUBSISTENCE_MINIMUM_BY_REGION, national, from 2011), which is seasonal.
